citation.title: Survival and Complication Rates of Feldspathic, Leucite-Reinforced, Lithium Disilicate and Zirconia Ceramic Laminate Veneers: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
citation.authors: Patrick Klein, Frank A. Spitznagel, Anja Zembic, Lea S. Prott, Stefano Pieralli, Brenda Bongaerts, Maria-Inti Metzendorf, Robert Langner, Petra C. Gierthmuehlen
citation.journal: Journal of Esthetic and Restorative Dentistry

s_design.anchor: SR/meta-analysis of observational and randomized clinical studies on ceramic laminate veneer survival and complication rates (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100)

domains.evidence_quote: To ensure transparency and avoid duplication, the study protocol was registered at the National Health Institute for Research PROSPERO, International Prospective Register for Systematic Reviews under the PROSPERO-­ ID: CRD42024568719.

The search was run from inception of each database up to February 19, 2024, in the following databases and study registers (Table 1): MEDLINE (via PubMed), the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (via Cochrane Library), Scopus, WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform and ClinicalTrials.gov.

The initial literature search yielded in a total of 12,592 ti-tles (Figure 1) and 14 records were additionally identified by screening reference lists. After de-­duplication, 7913 titles were imported into Rayyan [28]. Following title and abstract screen-ing a total of 98 articles were obtained for full-­text analysis. Subsequently, 29 studies (Tables 3–5) were eligible for inclusion and analyzed for data extraction.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.evidence_quote: Two authors (PK and FS) independently performed a risk of bias analysis of all included studies according to the Cochrane risk of bias Tool 2 (RoB 2.0) for randomized controlled clinical trials (RCTs) and according to MINOR (Methodological index for non-­randomized studies) for observational prognosis studies [31, 32].
A random-­effects model as proposed by DerSimonian and Laird was employed to estimate all pooled data [34].
A parametric regression approach (Egger's test) was employed to evaluate the degree of funnel plot asymmetry [35].

penalties.evidence_quote: The pooled survival rate for 1688 laminate veneers was 96.05% (95% CI: 93.87%–97.46%) at a mean follow-­up period of 10.4 years (I 2 = 69.07%) (Table 5, Figure 6).
penalties.note: Long-term follow-up up to a mean of 10.4 years is reported for survival and complication outcomes.

sources.interpretation_fa: این مطالعه مرور سیستماتیک و متاآنالیز بقا و عوارض ونیرهای سرامیکی را در بازه‌های کوتاه‌مدت، میان‌مدت و بلندمدت ارزیابی کرده است. یافته‌ها نشان‌دهنده نرخ بقای بالا برای سرامیک‌های فلدسپاتیک، LRGC و lithium disilicate با عوارض کمتر برای LDS در پیگیری‌های طولانی‌تر است. در عین حال، ناهمگونی بالای مطالعات و کمبود داده‌های بلندمدت برای zirconia در تفسیر دقیق تفاوت‌ها نقش دارند.

fidelity.source_conclusion: The long-­term performance of zirconia laminate veneers remains uncertain.
fidelity.fact_fa: از ۳۵ ادعایی که منبع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۳۵ مورد مطابق است، ۰ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق بالا؛ ۱ جمله‌ی دیگر در منبع نیامده است.
fidelity.interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با منبع مطابق است.
